subject: Security discovery: Private VPC, SOC 2 status and VSQ initiation
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Security discovery follow-up  Private VPC, SOC 2 & VSQ initiation

Hi Samantha  thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- Recap: Acme is evaluating Redwood for private inference (VPC / on-prem options) for a customer-facing analytics product. Main concerns were network isolation, data residency, and SOC 2/HIPAA posture.
- Immediate asks from your side: confirmation of SOC 2 status, an example private deployment diagram, and how vendor security questionnaires (VSQs) are handled.

What I can do from our side now: 
1) Kick off the VSQ  I attached our standard VSQ template (acme_vendor_vsq.xlsx) and will send a formal request to Acme security if you confirm the right contact.
2) Share Redwood private deployment options (PDF attached) with high-level network diagrams and air-gapped options.
3) Schedule a technical follow-up (30-45 min) with our Solutions Architect to go over VPC peering, PrivateLink, and deployment diagrams.

Requested items from Acme so we can prepare a tailored proposal: 
- Current network diagram (VPC/subnets, NAT gateways, firewall/VPN endpoints)  the file you showed on the call would be perfect (PDF is fine).
- Who in your security team should we coordinate with for the VSQ (email or alias).
- Timeline target for SOC 2 Type II report or any existing attestations.

Next steps I propose: 
- Samantha: send network diagram + security contact by EOD Tue (4/13) if possible.
- Marcus/Marissa: send VSQ request and private deployment options immediately.
- Set technical follow-up for next week  Wed 4/21 or Thu 4/22  let me know what works.

Attachments: acme_vendor_vsq.xlsx, private_deployment_options.pdf (high-level diagrams + air-gapped notes).

Thanks  talk soon.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acme-analytics.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security discovery follow-up  Private VPC, SOC 2 & VSQ initiation

Thanks Marcus  great summary. Confirming a few items from our side: 

- Network diagram: attaching the internal VPC diagram (acme_network_diagram_v2.pdf). That shows our prod and analytics VPCs, transit gateway, and where we currently host customer data.
- Security contact: looped in security@acme-analytics.com (they will own the VSQ). For initial review, you can contact our lead security engineer Raj Patel (raj.patel@acme-analytics.com).
- SOC 2: We completed SOC 2 Type I in 2025 and are currently mid-flight on a Type II audit  vendor-facing Type II report is expected by 2027-08-15. We also maintain GDPR data processing agreements and have some workloads marked for HIPAA compliance (Business Associate Agreement required).

On the deployment side: we are interested in both a Private VPC connection (PrivateLink or VPC peering) and an air-gapped/on-prem option for certain regulated customers. Please have your SAC( ) outline differences and any additional requirements for air-gapped installs (network, storage encryption, offline installers).

I can get the VSQ started once you confirm the scope and share the questionnaire. We can target a tech follow-up next Tue/Wed  I have availability 4/20 afternoon or 4/21 morning PDT.

Attachments: acme_network_diagram_v2.pdf

Sam
Samantha Lee
Head of Product Security, Acme Analytics
samantha.lee@acme-analytics.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security discovery follow-up  Private VPC, SOC 2 & VSQ initiation

Thanks Samantha  appreciate the quick turnaround and the diagram. Internal next steps from Redwood: 

- Rishi (security) / Laura (customer success) to review the attached network diagram and flag any potential blockers for a PrivateLink or VPC peering approach. Rishi  could you confirm whether our standard data-at-rest and in-transit controls align with Acme's HIPAA needs and what additional artifacts we should prepare?
- Marcus: I'll create the VSQ request in HubSpot and share the initial questionnaire (we typically use the attached acme_vendor_vsq.xlsx as a starting point).
- Tech session: propose Wed 2027-04-21 at 10:00 AM PDT. Marcus  can you invite our Solutions Architect (Ken Myers) and include an agenda: 1) network diagram walk-through, 2) VPC connectivity options, 3) air-gapped installer feasibility, 4) SOC 2 evidence ask and timelines.

I've attached our Private deployment options doc for Acme's review (private_deployment_options.pdf)  it includes: 
- VPC peering vs PrivateLink comparison
- Typical firewall rules and NAT patterns
- Air-gapped deployment checklist (hardware, offline installer, scoring matrix)

Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0199

Attachments: private_deployment_options.pdf, acme_vendor_vsq.xlsx

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acme-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security discovery follow-up  Private VPC, SOC 2 & VSQ initiation

Thanks Marissa  Wed 4/21 10:00 AM PDT works for us. Raj (cc'd via security alias) will join and can bring details on HIPAA-in-scope workloads.

We'll start the internal review of the VSQ and aim to return the initial pass by 2027-04-23. Regarding SOC 2 evidence  once your security team shares the standard evidence list, we can map to our controls. Expect the Type II report ready by 2027-08-15 as mentioned.

Looking forward to the technical session.

Sam
